title: Rooted in Gratitude: Restorative Yoga, Meditation & Sound Bath
description: A restorative Sunday gathering with yoga, guided meditation, sound bath, Ayurvedic teas, nourishing bites, and community connection
long_description:
A restorative Sunday gathering with yoga, guided meditation, sound bath, Ayurvedic teas, nourishing bites, and community connection

About this Event

Rooted in Gratitude is a restorative Sunday gathering created as a space to slow down, reconnect, and cultivate gratitude.
You’ll be guided through restorative yoga and meditation, followed by a soothing sound bath. The gathering will also include seasonal Ayurvedic teas and nourishing bites, with time to connect in community.
Each guest will receive a special Gift of Gratitude to take home as a reminder to carry the practice of gratitude beyond our time together.
Presented in collaboration by Lotus River Yoga & Wellness, Life of the Lotus Flower, and Vivae Alchemy.

Also check out other in Houston, Health & Wellness events in Houston.
